purpose: Choose one deterministic Q0 and Q1 route per registered task without using final-audit labels or navigation outcomes.

nominal_route_prior.rationale: A fixed conservative route-design prior, declared before execution and shared by both arms; it is not estimated from the final audit.

candidate_generation: All lane-graph polylines whose Manhattan legs lie in the registered driveable-region union; deterministic and independent of detector, correction, availability and final-audit labels.
selection_rule: Convert each geometry-only candidate into the runtime bounded-unicycle seed; fail closed unless the runtime rectangular-footprint rollout is valid and ends within 0.35 m of the task goal; among eligible candidates minimize the unchanged metric_expected_belief total cost; use candidate name only as an exact-cost tie break.

route_gate.additional_gate: The selector also requires the runtime swept rectangular-footprint rollout to pass; the centerline gate alone is not treated as body clearance.

final_audit_firewall: The final detector/localization audit decides release only. Its labels, residuals and outcomes do not enter candidate generation, route scoring or route selection.
execution_design: After selection, route JSON and source JSON are hash-bound. Five matched stochastic seeds replay each selected arm route. No global optimizer runs during a navigation replicate.
